dominance_rules.action: name the obligation class, flag verification of current rules in the customer's jurisdiction, and scope commitments to what verification concludes

dominance_rules.rule: Data-quality certification dominates every value claim made to a customer
dominance_rules.rationale: one mislabeled vehicle or stale geofence cited in a recap discredits every other number in the meeting
dominance_rules.trigger: building any recap, health brief, or expansion proposal that cites account data
dominance_rules.action: cite only audit-certified data, and fix or exclude uncertified items before the artifact leaves the shop

dominance_rules.rule: The support-cost floor dominates save depth
dominance_rules.rationale: a saved account held below its support cost converts retention into a compounding loss the book gate must later unwind
dominance_rules.trigger: any concession under consideration in a save or renewal negotiation
dominance_rules.action: bound the concession by the account's support-cost tier; below the floor, restructure or release cleanly

dominance_rules.rule: Device health dominates growth attention inside an account
dominance_rules.rationale: expanding into an account with dead units converts goodwill into a larger grievance and poisons the reference
dominance_rules.trigger: an expansion ask queued for an account with open health exceptions or a watch tier
dominance_rules.action: freeze the ask, fix the health exceptions first, and let the fix itself open the growth conversation

dominance_rules.rule: Mechanism honesty dominates persuasion in every commercial artifact
dominance_rules.rationale: invented per-unit figures and dressed-up benchmarks are the exact failure the content rules prohibit and customers eventually audit
dominance_rules.trigger: any price, margin, savings, or comparison statement being drafted
dominance_rules.action: state the mechanism and compute from the operator's or the customer's own recorded numbers, or state plainly that the number is unknown

dominance_rules.rule: Notice windows dominate scheduling across the book
dominance_rules.rationale: a missed window either locks an unwanted auto-renewal or strands subsidized hardware in a lapsed term
dominance_rules.trigger: any period's work planning while renewal dates approach
dominance_rules.action: schedule renewal preparation backward from each notice window ahead of discretionary work

dominance_rules.rationale: escalating collection on an invoice the ledger cannot defend converts a billing defect into lost trust and a churn
dominance_rules.trigger: an overdue account whose invoice is disputed on unit counts
dominance_rules.action: freeze escalation on the disputed amount, reconcile the three counts for that account, credit genuine errors, then resume the published ladder

anti_rework_rules.rule: Stand up the unit ledger before configuring monitoring, billing, or contracts on top of it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-keying every device, invoice line, and term linkage after the fact because movements could not be attributed to units

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record authorization scope and disclosure status per account before processing any turnover or expansion event
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unwinding unlawfully added units and re-running disclosure under pressure after activation

anti_rework_rules.rule: Certify data quality before building any renewal recap or expansion proposal
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding a collapsed recap after the customer spots a sold truck or stale geofence in the evidence

anti_rework_rules.rule: Reconcile the three counts before invoices are sent, not after disputes arrive
anti_rework_rules.prevents: credit memos, ghost-unit refunds, and the per-account audits a public dispute forces

anti_rework_rules.rule: Build the renewal calendar from notice windows before the first renewal approaches
anti_rework_rules.prevents: emergency renewal scrambles and auto-renew lock-ins that must be renegotiated under resentment

anti_rework_rules.rule: Retune alerts before adding new users, vehicles, or modules to an account
anti_rework_rules.prevents: training a larger audience to ignore the platform and then re-running adoption from a deeper hole

anti_rework_rules.rule: Inventory sunset and end-of-life exposure the day a lifecycle notice lands, before failures start
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an emergency truck-roll wave replacing units account by account at full cost during outages

anti_rework_rules.rule: Diagnose the churn driver before designing any save offer
anti_rework_rules.prevents: blanket discounts that fix nothing, re-churn after the concession, and a book trained to threaten

iteration_protocol.trigger: the silent-unit rate rises above the operator's watch threshold
iteration_protocol.action: run a health triage sweep, root-cause by device class and install cohort, and route the finding to hardware planning or back to the install practice

iteration_protocol.trigger: usage decay appears on an account whose devices are healthy
iteration_protocol.action: schedule an account health review, retune the noisiest alerts, and reconnect the platform to a live workflow need before the renewal window

iteration_protocol.trigger: the platform changes wholesale pricing, seat semantics, or tier packaging
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the per-unit margin mechanism across the ledger, update the tier map, and stage repricing into upcoming renewal windows with the mechanism explained
post-mortem the signal history against the scorecard, recalibrate signal weights, and feed the lesson into the next period's decision pass

iteration_protocol.trigger: a carrier sunset or vendor end-of-life notice lands
iteration_protocol.action: inventory affected units, build the swap campaign against the renewal calendar, and reserve loaners for early failures

iteration_protocol.trigger: a regulatory change is flagged for a fleet class present in the book
iteration_protocol.action: flag affected accounts, verify current rules in each jurisdiction before any commitment, and adjust module guidance and pending proposals to the verification

iteration_protocol.trigger: ticket volume per hundred units trends upward across two cycles
iteration_protocol.action: mine the cause tags for the top drivers and fix upstream - alert retunes, self-serve guides, or evidence routed to the install practice

priority_rationale: The ledger and the lawful-use guard come first because every monitoring, billing, and growth motion reads the unit lines and runs inside the authorization boundary; monitoring of devices, data, and engagement precedes the commercial layer because invoices, recaps, and asks are only as honest as the telemetry beneath them; contract, reconciliation, and turnover hygiene precede renewal and expansion because those motions execute against registered terms and reconciled counts; and the churn watch, save rules, and book gate close the loop last, converting outcomes back into recalibrated signals and next-period priorities.
